title: How Many?
short: The last number you say tells how many.
trouble: Asked how many, children count again instead of saying the last number.

blocks.html: When you finish counting, the last number you say tells how many there are. If you count 1, 2, 3, 4, then there are 4!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Count the frogs. The last number you say tells how many.

blocks.html: The last number you say is how many.

blocks.title: Ducks in a row
blocks.q: Ben counts the ducks: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. How many ducks?
steps: The last number Ben said is 5.

blocks.html: For the grown-up: After your child counts, ask “So how many are there?” If they count again from 1, show them: “You said 4 at the end. There are 4.” Then ask again another time. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Count toys into a basket, then ask how many.
Count apples in a bag at the store.
Line up shoes by the door and count them.
